name: workflow-mods
description: Small Claude Code mods for shipping, deploy verification, session status, usage limits and prompt-cache management.

plugins.name: mod-installer
plugins.description: Start here: type /mods to preview the workflow mods, tick the ones you want and install them.

plugins.name: all-mods
plugins.description: Everything in one install, no choices. Install this OR the individual mods, never both.

plugins.name: ship-it
plugins.description: A bare "deploy it" becomes the full ship checklist

plugins.name: deploy-verifier
plugins.description: After a push/merge/deploy: CI status and is the new version live

plugins.name: where-are-we
plugins.description: Session-start snapshot of branch, PR, gh sign-in and dev servers

plugins.name: close-out-check
plugins.description: Flags a stale CHANGELOG, version or handoff note after code changes

plugins.name: usage-guard
plugins.description: Rate-limit usage in the status line; guards agent fan-out

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Prompt-cache clock with Refresh, Compress and an optional Auto keep-alive
